obs1000: Uniform dark charcoal on all rails and posts. It is controlled and does not compete with the field. This is consistent in category with the blackened bustle rack in the Doha and Hansen analogues.
A small diagonal dark mark is present in 1000-front on the middle rail near the right end post (about x 900–930, y 495–505), with small dark ticks at the top-right corner.
Fine repetitive diagonal ticks along the rails in 1000-left and 1000-right are consistent with shadow-map acne.
Limit: no heat tint, paint remnant or value variation. It reads as 'black-painted rack' as easily as 'burnt rack'.
partFindingsVerbatim.shadowCause: Most likely renderer presentation. The mark sits at the junction where the perpendicular return arms and the end post meet the front plane, under the oblique key light. That position is consistent with a cast/contact shadow, and the acne ticks elsewhere show this rig produces self-shadow artifacts. The mesh has no UV per the brief, and a prior exact-GLB shadow-off control removed the mark. Not proven for this exact capture. Not an authored smear, and not to be painted over.
partFindingsVerbatim.obs256_128: Clean dark lattice. The mark is not visible at 256 front (sub-pixel) or at 128.
